# HITL FlatSat — Test Procedures

| | |
|---|---|
| Document | HITL-FLATSAT-TP |
| Version | 1.0 |
| Plan | [TEST_PLAN.md](TEST_PLAN.md) |

Every test case is automated. The steps below are the checks its script makes, in order. Each check prints `PASS [TC-nn.m]` or `FAIL [TC-nn.m]` followed by the values it measured, and the test report collects those lines. `tests/run_all.sh` runs all the stages; each case also gives the command to run it on its own.

| [TC-02](#tc-02) | Firmware unit tests | `unit:firmware` | 3 | automated |

| [TC-04](#tc-04) | Sensor and actuator drivers against 42 truth | `sil:devices` | 14 | automated |
| [TC-05](#tc-05) | Commanding and telemetry over the umbilical | `sil:umbilical` | 12 | automated |

## TC-01

**Interface definitions**

The interface code generated from the ICD is up to date, the Python codec and RF code pass their unit tests, and COSMOS decodes, encodes and displays exactly what the ICD defines.

- **Stage:** `unit:icd, unit:cosmos-defs`
- **Script:** `tools/icd_gen.py --check; tests/unit; tests/cosmos/check_defs.sh; tests/cosmos/check_screens.py`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-01.1 | Generated files up to date | icd_gen --check reports no stale file | SYS-06 |
| TC-01.2 | Codec and RF unit tests | all Python unit tests pass | SYS-06, SYS-07 |
| TC-01.3 | COSMOS definitions match the codec | every packet decodes and encodes identically | SYS-06 |
| TC-01.4 | COSMOS screens match the definitions | every widget and button names an existing item or command | SYS-06 |

## TC-02

**Firmware unit tests**

The flight libraries pass their unit tests on a fake HAL, and the wheel speed loop and ADCS laws meet their performance in closed loop with plant models.

- **Stage:** `unit:firmware`
- **Script:** `firmware/build/test_common, test_wheel_ctrl, test_adcs`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-02.1 | Common flight libraries | all checks pass (CCSDS, time, scheduler, umbilical, persistence, CAN, node protocol, RF frames) | SYS-04, SYS-06, SYS-07 |
| TC-02.2 | Wheel speed loop in closed loop | 300 rpm step settles within 5 % in < 1.5 s with < 10 % overshoot; no wind-up | SYS-08 |
| TC-02.3 | ADCS laws in closed loop | detumble from 5.4-10.2 deg/s to < 2 deg/s in < 120 s; sun pointing within 2 deg in < 150 s; eclipse damping; momentum dump | SYS-01, SYS-02 |

## TC-03

**HIL bridge end to end (test environment)**

The HIL bridge carries every frame type between a stand-in MCU and NOS3 (test environment qualification).

- **Stage:** `e2e:bridge`
- **Script:** `nos3/components/hil_bridge/support/e2e_test.sh`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-03.1 | Heartbeat round trip | reply received | ENV |
| TC-03.2 | I2C transaction to the EPS sim | housekeeping values as configured | ENV |
| TC-03.3 | Invalid bus rejected | BAD_REQ | ENV |
| TC-03.4 | UART path | sample sim echoes NOOP | ENV |
| TC-03.5 | Umbilical TM and TC | both directions delivered | ENV |
| TC-03.6 | RF frames with RSSI/SNR | frame and metadata delivered | ENV |
| TC-03.7 | Torquer command | reaches the torquer sim | ENV |
| TC-03.8 | Simulation time | TIME frames advance 1 s per second | ENV |

## TC-04

**Sensor and actuator drivers against 42 truth**

Every OBC driver reads or commands its NOS3 device correctly, compared with 42's truth while the spacecraft tumbles.

- **Stage:** `sil:devices`
- **Script:** `firmware/build/test_devices`
- **Configuration:** SIL with a 5.4 deg/s tumble

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-04.1 | Umbilical link | bridge answers | ENV |
| TC-04.2 | Simulation time | TIME frames advance with the simulation | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.3 | 42 truth stream | receiving | ENV |
| TC-04.4 | IMU | rates within 0.05 deg/s of truth | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.5 | Magnetometer | |B| within 2 % and direction within 3 deg of truth | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.6 | Coarse sun sensors | outputs match cos(Sun angle) within 0.02 | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.7 | Fine sun sensor | valid frame and error code | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.8 | Star tracker | quaternion matches truth | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.9 | Reaction wheel momentum | matches truth | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.10 | Reaction wheel torque | 0.5 mN m for 2 s adds 1 mN m s within 5 % | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.11 | EPS housekeeping | values as configured | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.12 | EPS switch command | confirmed in housekeeping | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.13 | Magnetorquers | commands sent; out-of-range duty rejected | SYS-06 |
| TC-04.14 | GPS | position within 500 m and velocity within 1 m/s of truth | SYS-06 |

## TC-06

**CAN nodes, FlatSat power and the physical wheel**

The OBC operates the ADCS and EPS nodes over CAN, including switch and reset fault injection.

- **Stage:** `sil:can-nodes`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_can_nodes.py`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-06.1 | Nodes up | alive mask 0x0E, CAN traffic without errors | SYS-04 |
| TC-06.2 | FlatSat power telemetry | battery 3.6-4.2 V; rail currents in range | SYS-05 |
| TC-06.3 | Physical wheel speed step | within 20 rpm of 300 rpm | SYS-08 |
| TC-06.4 | Motor current on the ADCS rail | rises > 10 mA above idle | SYS-05 |
| TC-06.5 | Motor power cut | fault reported, wheel coasts below 150 rpm in 3 s | SYS-08, SYS-04 |
| TC-06.6 | Motor power restored | wheel back to 300 rpm | SYS-08 |
| TC-06.7 | ADCS node held in reset | node lost reported, rail current drops | SYS-04 |
| TC-06.8 | ADCS node released | node up with reset cause POWER_ON, wheel resumes | SYS-04 |
| TC-06.9 | Commanded node reset | acknowledged; reboot reported with reset cause COMMAND | SYS-04 |
| TC-06.10 | Leaving TEST | wheel override ends | SYS-08 |

## TC-07

**Sensor fault persistence and isolation**

Isolated misses are tolerated, persistent ones declared and recovered, and one failed device doesn't affect the others.

- **Stage:** `sil:faults`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_fault_persistence.sh`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-07.1 | Normal operation | no missed reads | SYS-03 |
| TC-07.2 | 1.5 s IMU outage | misses counted, no fault declared | SYS-03 |
| TC-07.3 | 6 s IMU outage | one fault and one recovery event | SYS-03 |
| TC-07.4 | Fault isolated | no other device faulted, umbilical up | SYS-03 |
| TC-07.5 | IMU simulator frozen | other buses unaffected, umbilical up (42 stalls too: GPS fixes stop and the magnetometer freezes, and both may be declared failed) | SYS-03 |

## TC-08

**Attitude control in the loop with 42**

From a tumble, the OBC detumbles, hands over to sun pointing and converges on its own, checked against 42's truth; then fault, low-battery and command validation responses.

- **Stage:** `sil:adcs`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_adcs.py`
- **Configuration:** SIL with a 5.4 deg/s tumble

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-08.1 | Tumble detected | SAFE to DETUMBLE automatically, torquers active | SYS-01 |
| TC-08.2 | Detumble | below 2 deg/s (42 truth) and SUN_POINT automatically | SYS-01 |
| TC-08.3 | Sun pointing converges | < 5 deg (42 truth) in < 5 min; estimate within 3 deg of truth | SYS-02 |
| TC-08.4 | Pointing held | < 5 deg for 30 s; wheel torque within 1 mN m | SYS-02 |
| TC-08.5 | IMU failure in SUN_POINT | SAFE within 10 s; stays in SAFE after recovery | SYS-03 |
| TC-08.6 | Low battery | LOW_POWER within 20 s; ADCS_STATE drops to 0.1 Hz | SYS-05 |
| TC-08.7 | Battery recovered | back to SAFE with reason BATTERY_RECOVERED | SYS-05 |
| TC-08.8 | Invalid gains rejected | NaN and negative gains rejected; auto modes switchable | SYS-06 |

## TC-09

**RF link**

Store and forward, telecommands over RF, frame checks, link loss and beacon control, end to end through the ground station.

- **Stage:** `sil:rf-link`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_rf_link.py`
- **Configuration:** ground station out of contact at start (--mode never --seed 1)

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-09.1 | Ground station status | out of contact, next pass predicted | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.2 | Out of contact | beacons sent but unheard; data held on board and at the ground | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.3 | AOS | stored events delivered; queued telecommand executed | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.4 | Beacons in contact | at least 2 in 21 s | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.5 | RF round trip and request | ping answered; packet downlinked on request | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.6 | Corrupted uplink frames | rejected and counted (CRC) | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.7 | 50 % frame loss | frames lost and delivered, both counted | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.8 | LOS | contact lost noticed on board within 60 s | SYS-07 |
| TC-09.9 | Beacon control | off stops transmissions; 3 s rejected; 10 s restored | SYS-07 |

**RF pass over NASA Wallops**

A real pass from 42's orbit, against the ground station's own prediction.

- **Stage:** `sil:rf-pass`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_rf_pass.py`
- **Configuration:** ground station at Wallops (37.9402 N, 75.4664 W)

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|

| TC-10.2 | AOS | within 15 s of the prediction (simulation time) | SYS-07 |

## TC-12

**Actuator, node and bus failures**

Fault injection beyond the sensors - a failed wheel, a failed magnetometer during detumble, crashed nodes and a lost CAN bus.

- **Stage:** `sil:failures`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_failures.py`
- **Configuration:** SIL in SUN_POINT and DETUMBLE

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-12.1 | Reaction wheel failure in SUN_POINT | wheels declared failed; SAFE within 10 s | SYS-03 |
| TC-12.2 | Magnetometer failure in DETUMBLE | declared failed; SAFE within 10 s | SYS-03 |
| TC-12.3 | ADCS node crash in SUN_POINT | node lost within 5 s; SAFE; restart reported | SYS-04 |
| TC-12.4 | EPS node crash | node lost within 5 s; restart reported | SYS-04 |
| TC-12.5 | CAN bus loss | both nodes lost within 5 s; ADCS node stops the wheel; recovery on restore | SYS-04, SYS-08 |

**FlatSat power measurement and wheel performance**

The EPS node's measurements against the plant's true values, and the physical wheel's step responses and mirroring.

- **Script:** `tests/system/test_hardware_twin.py`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|

## TC-14

**One-orbit endurance**

A full orbit (about 95 minutes) without intervention: attitude held in sunlight and through eclipse, eclipse detection against 42's geometry, wheel momentum bounded, no faults and no telemetry gaps. About 100 minutes: run with tests/run_all.sh all or tests/run_all.sh orbit.

- **Stage:** `sil:orbit`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_orbit.py`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-14.1 | Pointing in sunlight | within 2 deg after convergence | SYS-02 |
| TC-14.2 | Eclipse detection | within 30 s of 42's geometric eclipse entry and exit | SYS-02, SYS-05 |
| TC-14.3 | Reacquisition after eclipse | within 5 deg in < 5 min | SYS-02 |
| TC-14.4 | Wheel momentum | stays below 50 % of capacity | SYS-02 |
| TC-14.5 | Health | no event of WARNING severity or above, mode SUN_POINT throughout, no telemetry gap > 5 s | SYS-03, SYS-06 |

## TC-15

**Comparison with NASA's reference ADCS** *(blocked)*

The same scenario flown by NOS3's own flight software (cFS with the generic ADCS app), as a benchmark for the FlatSat's detumble and sun pointing. Blocked: in this environment the reference ADCS commands wheel torques far beyond the wheels' limit (NCR-015), so the comparison wouldn't be fair; available on demand.

- **Stage:** `sil:reference`
- **Script:** `tests/system/test_reference_adcs.py`

| Step | Check | Pass criterion | Requirements |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-15.1 | Detumble benchmark | informative: time to 2 deg/s, FlatSat vs cFS | SYS-01 |
| TC-15.2 | Sun pointing benchmark | informative: time to 5 deg and steady-state error, FlatSat vs cFS | SYS-02 |
